title: Distribution of IIT Madras Electronic Kit to Connect 1 Lakh Children In Govt. Schools in Tamil Nadu
description: Thiru. M.K.Stalin, Hon'ble Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu will inaugurate the distribution of IIT Madras Electronic Kit to connect 1 Lakh children In Govt. Schools in Tamil Nadu to Electronic Sciences on April 5, 2023, 5:30 PM at TTJ Auditorium, IC & SR Building, IIT Madras. Thiru. Anbil Mahesh Poyyamozhi, Hon'ble Minister, School Education, Tamil Nadu will deliver the keynote address. Prof. V. Kamakoti, Director, IIT Madras will preside over the function.
